summary: Tested the change that makes free courses need an explicit enroll, plus the new My courses tab. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Covered: enrolled/owned flags, 403 before enroll, enroll is idempotent, 402 on a paid course (TEST_ course inserted for the test, then deleted), 404 on an unknown id, 401 when unauthenticated, landing flags, and admin ownership. Frontend: tab order is right and the default tab is All courses when nothing is enrolled. My courses empty state and the Browse all button work. Enroll from a card stays on the page, shows a toast, switches to My courses, and shows 'Enrolled · 0%' with a progress bar. The card links to the player, which loads. After a reload the default tab is My courses. The landing page shows Enroll for free when not enrolled, then redirects to /app/courses?tab=my; it shows Go to course once enrolled and Sign in to enroll free when logged out. Paid flow was only code-reviewed because no paid course exists: BuyCard Action onPaid and the CourseLanding cf_order handler both navigate to /app/courses?tab=my.

minor.issue: students() counts only purchases and lesson_progress, not course_enrollments, so the landing page still shows '0 students' after a free enroll
can_review is based only on lesson_progress, so a student who enrolled but hasn't started cannot review. Probably intended, just flagging.

action_items: Optional: include db.course_enrollments user_ids in students() count
critical_code_review_comments: Old test_academy_courses_v2.py tests that assume free courses are auto-owned are now outdated and should be updated or removed
